name: warmup
note: Five orders, nothing awkward. Four of them trade, one is refused by the exchange. No cancels, no duplicate messages, no restart. Get this green before you look at main.

actions.note: AAPL on NASDAQ in USD. The exchange trades it in several pieces, so this order ends up with more than one execution.

Selling some of the AAPL bought above, so the inventory report has a security with buys and sells.
